page_text_ocr_zh:
■作者的话
最初的“我的东西”
时间真的过得很快，我的孩子已经3岁了。我觉得带孩子也轻松了一点。但是，孩子大了，大人也会有不同的辛苦，我也终于开始明白抚养孩子是没有终结的。
在孩子2岁半的时候，我开始给他买了可爱的、印有卡通形象的小碗和小勺。开始他非常高兴，一边说着“我的，我的”，一边自己很主动地吃东西。于是我觉得“嗯，不错，这很管用”。
过了一段时间，我坐在平时太太一直坐的椅子上看报纸。“这张椅子是妈妈的。”孩子突然说了一句。然而，这仅仅是个开始，在平时的生活中，孩子会清楚地区别出每样东西的物主，我们大人搞错的时候他就会指出来。（不知道为什么，对于父亲，他会更加严格一些……）
可能对于孩子来说，对事物的归属感的认识是他们对人类社会中一些规则的最初了解。今后孩子们会拥有越来越多的自己的物品，我们不希望他们忘记拥有物品时的快乐和喜悦。我觉得，我们应该教会他们对现在应有尽有时代的感恩，让他们能够有一颗关心、爱护每一样事物的美好心灵。
2007年夏
■作者介绍
三浦太郎（MIURA TARO）
1968年出生于日本爱知县。他在大阪艺术大学美术学科就读时，就已经在日本图画展中获奖。毕业后，作为自由撰稿人，他主要从事广告类工作，同时也涉及图书、杂志的封面及装帧设计。
他的作品几度入选意大利博洛尼亚国际绘本原画展。在日本出版图画书之前，他已经分别在瑞士和意大利出版了两本图画书：《JE SUIS ...》（瑞士La joie de lire出版社）和《Ton》（意大利Edizioni Corraini出版社）。
《连在一起》是他在日本出版的第一本图画书，一经问世便荣登婴儿图画书畅销榜的第一名，获得了众多读者的推崇。此书中文简体字版已由本社出版。

page_text_en:
■ Author's Note
The First 'My Things'
Time really flies. My child is already 3 years old. I feel that raising him has become a bit easier. But as the child grows, adults also face different kinds of hardships. I finally began to understand that raising a child never truly ends.
When my child was 2 and a half years old, I started buying him cute little bowls and spoons with cartoon characters. At first, he was very happy, saying 'Mine, mine' while actively eating on his own. So I thought, 'Well, this is quite effective.'
After some time, I was sitting in the chair my wife usually sits in while reading a newspaper. 'This chair is Mommy's,' the child suddenly said. However, this was just the beginning. In daily life, the child clearly distinguishes the owner of every item, and whenever we adults get it wrong, he points it out. (For some reason, he is even stricter with his father...)
Perhaps for children, recognizing ownership is their first understanding of some rules in human society. In the future, children will own more and more of their own things. We don't want them to forget the joy and happiness of owning things. I believe we should teach them to be grateful for the abundance of the present era, and help them develop a kind and caring heart for every object.
Summer 2007
■ Author Introduction
Miura Taro (MIURA TARO)
Born in Aichi Prefecture, Japan in 1968. While studying at Osaka University of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, he had already won awards at the Japanese Picture Book Exhibition. After graduation, as a freelance writer, he mainly worked in advertising, while also engaging in cover and book design for books and magazines.
His works have been selected multiple times for the Bologna International Children's Book Fair in Italy. Before publishing picture books in Japan, he had already published two picture books in Switzerland and Italy: 'JE SUIS ...' (published by La joie de lire, Switzerland) and 'Ton' (published by Edizioni Corraini, Italy).
'Connected Together' is his first picture book published in Japan. It immediately topped the bestseller list for baby picture books and received widespread acclaim from readers. The simplified Chinese version of this book has been published by this publisher.
